en.title: Super-Dimensional Fusion! Gigant Blaze: The Steel God of the Lost Village
en.premise: A world is ravaged by a hopeless monster disaster. A boy, clutching a mysterious ancient book he found in a second‑hand shop, is led to a legendary village that was thought to have vanished. There, he awakens a super‑massive robot that harbors the heat capable of scorching the universe! A fiery saga where he ignites his soul and smashes despair with steel fists now begins!

zh.title: 超次元合体！Gigant·Blaze：失落村庄的钢铁神
zh.premise: 一个被绝望的怪兽灾害侵袭的世界。少年在旧书店里发现了一本神秘古籍，随之被引向本应已消失的传说之村。在那里，他唤醒了一台蕴藏着足以焚尽宇宙热量的超巨型机器人！燃烧灵魂，以钢铁拳头粉碎绝望的热血战记，现已拉开序幕！
